findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: This clause allows the client to terminate immediately without giving you any notice or paying for work already completed or expenses incurred.
findings.suggested_change: Modify the clause to require written notice and ensure the client must pay for all services rendered and expenses incurred up to the termination date.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers immediately upon delivery, before you have received payment. If the client refuses to pay, they still legally own the work.
findings.suggested_change: Change the term so that intellectual property rights transfer to the client only upon receipt of full and final payment for the deliverables.

findings.explanation: Waiting up to 90 days for invoice payment puts a severe cash flow strain on you as a freelancer.
findings.suggested_change: Propose standard payment terms of Net 30 or require milestone deposits.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am looking forward to working together. Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose a few adjustments: - Regarding the relevant clause about termination, it allows ending the arrangement without notice or payment; I propose modifying the agreement to require written notice and ensure payment for all services rendered and expenses incurred up to the termination date. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning intellectual property, ownership transfers upon delivery before payment; I propose changing the term so that rights transfer to the client only upon receipt of full and final payment for the deliverables. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment terms, waiting up to 90 days causes cash flow strain; I propose standard payment terms of Net 30 or requiring milestone deposits. Thank you for considering these adjustments. Best regards,
